purpose: Select one previously unprepared supported English input without inspecting Albanian candidate behavior.

inputPopulation.authority: existing frozen bundled CMUdict eligible pronunciation population
inputPopulation.populationEligibility: Use lexical words having at least one existing population-spec entry with eligibility=ELIGIBLE. The frozen population-spec eligibility is source-variant resolution through pronunciation-to-Voice plus non-null ZC composition; no Discovery candidate query is consulted.

normalizationAndEligibility.normalization: NFC, trim, lower-case with the existing English CMUdict normalization convention.
normalizationAndEligibility.usableInputRule: Retain only normalized lexical words matching /^[a-z]+$/u.
normalizationAndEligibility.deduplication: One population item per normalized lexical word; source variants do not create duplicate selection items.
normalizationAndEligibility.invalidEntryRule: Exclude punctuation, apostrophes, digits, periods, and other non-ASCII-letter lexical forms before ordering.

preparedWordExclusion.rule: Exclude words materially used as M1-M6 analysis targets, fixtures, canonical examples, research targets, structural or functional proof inputs, friction-probe inputs, or known regression/acceptance inputs. Ordinary prose in unrelated documents is not itself an exclusion.

ordering.comparison: Unicode code-point ascending comparison of normalized lexical words

selection.rule: Select the first eligible normalized lexical word after normalization, usability filtering, deduplication, and prepared-word exclusion.
selection.coverageAssessment: Not part of primary selection. Any later coverage assessment must be separately frozen before execution.
